title: Stereotypes and Smut: The (Mis)representation of Non-cisgender Identities by Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images using text-to-image models with prompts containing diverse cisgender and non-cisgender identity terms (e.g., transgender, nonbinary, genderqueer) and manually annotating the outputs for photorealism, dehumanization, stereotypes, symbols/flags, and sexualization (implied nudity).

Instructing annotators to indicate the presence of non-white individuals in the generated images to measure ethnic diversity and the models' reliance on a default norm of whiteness, especially when rendering intersectional identities (e.g., Two-spirit, Latinx).
